paper_metadata.title: 100-Gb/s Multiplexing and Demultiplexing IC Operations in InP HEMT Technology
paper_metadata.abstract: This paper describes the 100-Gb/s multiplexing operation of a selector IC and demultiplexing operation of a D-type flip-flop (D-FF) using production-level 0.1m-gate-length InP HEMT IC technology. To boost the operating speed of the selector IC, a selector core circuit directly drives an external 50load, and is included in the output stage. In addition, a test chip containing the selector and a D-FF to confirm error-free operation of these circuits was designed. The fabricated selector IC exhibited clear eye openings at 100 Gb/s, and its error-free operation was confirmed by using the test chip.
